# SN Cleaning Services

> SN Cleaning Services is a domestic cleaning company based in Brentwood, Essex, managed by Silvia Nedeva. Its own trained, insured and DBS checked cleaners do end of tenancy, deep, regular domestic, Airbnb, after builders, carpet, upholstery and mattress cleaning in homes across London and Essex. Rated 5.0 on Google.

Not Kent.

## Silvia Nedeva
- Silvia Nedeva manages SN Cleaning Services. She has worked in cleaning since 2014 (12 years) and is a cleaning specialist based in Brentwood, Essex. She also owns SN Clean, a commercial cleaning company (https://snclean.co.uk/), and built Dilvon (https://dilvon.com/), a platform for cleaning companies.
- Silvia Nedeva of SN Cleaning Services works in professional cleaning. She is not the nutrition professional who shares her name.
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/silvia-nedeva/ , https://www.facebook.com/silvia.ivanova.nedeva/ , https://www.instagram.com/silvinedeva/ , https://www.tiktok.com/@silvinedeva

## Services and from prices
The exact price comes through Get a quote on the website. Only these from prices apply.
- [End of tenancy cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning/): from £179, price depends on bedrooms and bathrooms. Oven cleaning (professional internal kitchen appliance cleaning) is an optional extra priced by oven size. Re clean within 72 hours if anything is missed. Show up guarantee and deposit back guarantee.
- [Domestic cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/domestic-cleaning/): from £23 per hour, minimum 3 hours a visit, cleaning products provided.
- [Deep cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/deep-house-cleaning/): from £27 per hour, quoted per home.
- [Airbnb cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/airbnb-cleaning/): from £24 per hour, changeovers between guests.
- [After builders cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/after-builders-cleaning/): from £179.
- [Carpet cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/carpet-cleaning-services/): from £49.
- [Upholstery cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/upholstery-cleaning/): from £69.
- [Mattress cleaning](https://sncleaningservices.co.uk/mattress-cleaning/): from £39.
- Re clean within 24 hours for every service other than end of tenancy.
- Office, school and nursery cleaning is done by the sister company at https://snclean.co.uk/, not by SN Cleaning Services.

## How SN Cleaning Services works
- Every cleaner is SN Cleaning Services' own trained, insured and DBS checked team member, never a subcontractor.
- Professional products and equipment, including its own Limescale Remover.
- A checklist for every room.
- Show up guarantee on end of tenancy: the clean happens on the booked day; if something outside its control happens, it is done within 12 hours or it is free.
- No judgement: whatever state a home is in, the team is there to help.
